question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON CAST(m.title_id AS INTEGER) = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = CAST(w1.id AS VARCHAR)
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = CAST(w2.id AS VARCHAR)
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration = '00:43'
LIMIT 1
